prompt: Inputs are arbitrary integers. Return the smallest multiple of b greater than or equal to a. Return -1 unless 0 <= a <= 65535 and b is one of 1,2,4,8,16,32,64. Output Python source defining f(a, b), with optional int/bool annotations and no defaults. A single enclosing ```python fence is accepted but unnecessary. Allowed: integer/bool literals, local assignments, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, + - * // % & | ^ ~ << >>. No imports, calls, loops or other syntax. All intermediate integers must fit signed 128 bits; shift counts must be 0..63.
